baseline.conditions: One weather wait and one load/transfer day; only in safe conditions.

title: An empty berth is useful
daily_life: The Nacre Quay to Aurel Quay connection serves trade, craft and people visiting relatives. A canceled departure leaves kitchens, workshops and lodging under pressure.
timing: 340 km at 100 km/day takes 3.4 movement days. One weather-wait day plus one load/transfer day gives 5.4 elapsed days, scheduled as 6 whole day blocks.
handoff: The named sky link is a regional service, not proof that liftstone works everywhere along a straight map line. The selected craft’s support, propulsion, field compatibility and reserve must be established before an airborne sequence.
story_option: A captain wins praise for leaving a berth empty, then privately accepts cargo that consumes its weight reserve. Evidence is in the actual load, not the heroic speech.
production: Do not turn distant liftstone into free-floating ore. The network map is topological; it cannot certify the complete airborne track or the field envelope.
direction: Listed a-to-b planning reference; reverse passage requires a fresh itinerary.
geometry: Regional endpoints and route length inherited; connecting line is not a surveyed track.
